app.title: Qfza
app.pageTitle: Qfza — Find the moments that matter
app.metaDescription: Qfza — Jump to the moments that matter

hero.title: Jump to the exact moment a phrase is spoken
hero.subtitle: Paste a YouTube URL, enter a word or phrase, and jump straight to every matching moment.

features.title: Why Qfza
features.exactDesc: We search the full transcript word by word, so you only get timestamps where the exact phrase appears — no fuzzy matches.
features.fastDesc: A new video may take a few minutes to process. Repeat searches can reuse a cached transcript instead of starting over.
features.jumpDesc: Every result links straight to the exact moment, so you watch the scene instead of scrubbing.

steps.title: How it works
steps.step1Desc: A public YouTube video, not a channel or playlist.
steps.step2Desc: A single word or a full sentence.
steps.step3Desc: Open an exact timestamp once your search is ready.

footer.note: Qfza — Find the moments that matter

form.title: Search a YouTube video for a word or phrase
form.keywordPlaceholder: e.g. never gonna give you up
form.helperSpeed: First search: a few minutes. Cached searches are usually faster.
form.helperPrivacy: Nothing is stored beyond the session cache.
form.helperDetails: Qfza sends the link and phrase to our server to fetch the transcript and match it word for word. Transcripts are kept only in the session cache so repeat searches on the same video can reuse them, nothing is written to a database, and your search phrase is never stored.
form.pasteEmpty: Your clipboard is empty. Copy a YouTube URL first, then try Paste again.
form.pasteManual: On a phone, touch and hold the URL field and choose Paste. On a computer, press Ctrl/⌘+V.
form.processingHint: Search in progress. Cancel to edit the URL or phrase.
form.searchAgainHint: Edit the URL or phrase to search again.
form.helperSources: Use a public YouTube video, not a channel or playlist. Shorts, live and embed links need a watch/share link instead. Private or restricted videos may be unavailable.

status.title: Transcribing video
status.message: This can take a few minutes. We will show your results as soon as the transcript is ready.
status.stillWorking: Still working… this is taking longer than usual.

player.title: Video preview
player.loadingMoment: Loading video — we’ll jump to {{timestamp}} when it’s ready.
player.unavailableHint: The embedded player couldn’t load. You can still open the video or a matching moment on YouTube.
player.playbackBlocked: Playback didn’t start. Press Play in the video, or open this moment on YouTube.

results.title: Matches for “<keyword>{{keyword}}</keyword>”
results.hint: Click a match to jump to that moment
results.empty: No exact matches found. Try a different word or phrase.
results.emptyHint: Try a shorter phrase or a distinctive word from the sentence.
results.idle: Your matches will appear here after you search.
results.idleMockLabel: Illustrative preview of what a search returns
results.copyFailed: Could not copy results to the clipboard. Please try again.
results.noMatchesTooltip: No matches to copy or export
results.watchMoment: Watch on YouTube at {{timestamp}} (opens in a new tab)

error.validation: Please enter a YouTube URL and a word or phrase.

error.jobGone: This transcription job no longer exists. Please search again.

error.unsupportedFormat: Open the video’s watch page and copy its youtube.com/watch?v=… link, or use a youtu.be share link.
error.retryHint: Try again uses the URL and phrase currently shown in the form.
